1. Our Service

Card AI is a mobile app designed to help users scan, search, identify, organize, and track trading cards and sports cards.

The app may provide features including:

  • Card scanning and identification
  • Card information lookup
  • Price and value reference
  • Collection tracking
  • Portfolio management
  • Wishlist or saved card features
  • Raw and graded card information when available
  • Support for selected TCG and sports card categories

Card AI currently supports or may support categories including Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, One Piece, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Disney Lorcana, Digimon, Star Wars: Unlimited, Flesh and Blood, basketball cards, baseball cards, and football cards.

We may update, modify, add, remove, suspend, or discontinue any part of the Service at any time.

5. Card Scanning Feature

Card AI may request access to your device camera so you can scan trading cards or sports cards.

By using the scanning feature, you understand and agree that:

  • Scan results may not always be accurate.
  • Image quality, lighting, angle, card condition, language, finish, set variation, parallel version, grading label, or database limitations may affect recognition results.
  • You are responsible for reviewing and confirming scan results before saving cards to your collection.
  • Scanned images may be processed temporarily to identify cards and provide the Service.
  • We may use aggregated, anonymized, or de-identified technical information to improve scanning performance and app quality.

You may not use the scanning feature to upload unlawful, harmful, infringing, abusive, or unauthorized content.

Development Tools Not Included in the Application

MMDetection, MMCV, MMEngine, MMDeploy, ONNX, and OpenCV were used in model training, conversion, validation, or as preprocessing references. Their libraries are not included in the current mobile application. In particular, the mobile image-resize implementation matches OpenCV's half-pixel bilinear sampling behavior but does not include OpenCV.
